ja518:1.1: anigūḷhamantaṃ asaññataṃ aparicakkhitāraṃ bhayaṃ tam anveti sayaṃ abodhaṃ nāgaṃ yathā Paṇḍarakaṃ supaṇṇo.
ja518:2.1: Yo guyhamantaṃ parirakkhaneyyaṃ mohā naro saṃsati bhāsamāno taṃ bhinnamantaṃ bhayam anveti khippaṃ nāgaṃ yathā Paṇḍarakaṃ supaṇṇo.
ja518:3.1: Nānumitto garuṃ atthaṃ guyhaṃ vedetum arahati sumitto ca asambuddhaṃ sambuddhaṃ vā anatthavā.
ja518:4.1: Vissāsam āpajjim ahaṃ: acelo samaṇo ayaṃ sammato bhāvitatto, tassāham akkhiṃ vivariṃ guyhaṃ atthaṃ, ātītamattho kapaṇo rudāmi.
ja518:5.1: Tassāhaṃ paramaṃ brahme guyhaṃ vācaṃ h' imaṃ nāsakkhi saṃyametuṃ, tappakkhato hi bhayam āgataṃ mama, atītamattho kapaṇo rudāmi,
ja518:6.1: Yo ve naro suhadaṃ maññamāno guyhaṃ atthaṃ saṃsati dukkulīne dosā bhayā athavā rāgaratto pallittho bālo asaṃsayaṃ so.
ja518:7.1: Tirokkhavāco asataṃ paviṭṭho yo saṃgatīsu-m-udīreti vākyaṃ āsīviso dummukho ty-āhu taṃ naraṃ, ārā arā saṃyame tādisamhā.
ja518:8.1: Annaṃ pānaṃ kāsikaṃ candanañ ca manāpiṭṭhiyo mālamucchādanañ ca ohāya gacchāmase sabbakāme, supaṇṇa pāṇupagatā va ty-amhā 'ti.
ja518:9.1: Ko n' idha tiṇṇaṃ garahaṃ upeti asmin dha loke pāṇabhū nāgarāja: samaṇo supaṇṇo athavā tav' eva, kiṃkāraṇā Paṇḍaraka-ggahīto ti gātham āha.
ja518:10.1: Samaṇo ti me sammatatto ahosi piyo ca me manasā bhāvitatto, tasmāham akkhiṃ vivariṃ guyham atthaṃ, atītamattho kapaṇaṃ rudāmīti.
ja518:11.1: Na c' atthi satto amaro pathavyā, paññāvidhā n' atthi na ninditabbā, saccena dhammena dhiyā damena alabbham avyāharatī naro idha.
ja518:12.1: Mātāpitā paramā bandhavānaṃ, nāssa tatiyo anukampak' atthi, tesam pi guyhaṃ paramaṃ na saṃse mantassa bhedaṃ parisaṃkamāno.
ja518:13.1: Mātāpitā bhaginī bhātaro ca sabhāya vā yassa hontī sapakkhā tesam pi guyhaṃ paramaṃ na saṃse mantassa bhedaṃ parisaṃkamāno.
ja518:14.1: Bhariyā ce purisaṃ vajjā komārī piyabhāṇinī puttarūpayasūpetā ñātisaṃghapurakkhatā tassāpi guyhaṃ paramaṃ na saṃse mantassa bhedaṃ parisaṃkamāno ti.
ja518:15.1: Na guyham atthaṃ vivareyya rakkheyya naṃ yathā nidhiṃ, na hi pātukato sādhu guyho attho pajānatā.
ja518:16.1: Thiyā guyhaṃ na saṃseyya amittassa ca paṇḍito yo cāmisena saṃhīro hadayatthe no ca yo naro.
ja518:17.1: Guyham attham asambuddhaṃ sambodhayati yo naro mantabhedabhayā tassa dāsabhūto tikkhati.
ja518:18.1: Yāvanto purisass' atthaṃ guyhaṃ jānanti mantinaṃ tāvanto tassa ubbegā, tasmā guyhaṃ na vissaje.
ja518:19.1: Vivicca bhāseyya divā rahassaṃ, rattiṃ giraṃ nātivelaṃ pamuñce, upassutikā hi suṇanti mantaṃ, tasmā manto khippam upeti bhedan ti
ja518:20.1: Yathāpi assa nagaraṃ mahantaṃ āḷārakaṃ āyasaṃ Bhaddasālaṃ samantakhātāparikhāupetaṃ evam pi me te idha guyhamantā.
ja518:21.1: Ye guyhamantā avikiṇṇavācā deḷhā sadatthesu narā dujivhā ārā amittā vyavajanti tehi āsīvisā vā-r-iva sattusaṃghā ti dvīsu
ja518:22.1: gāthāsu. Hitvā gharaṃ pabbajito acelo naggo muṇḍo carati ghāsahetu, tamhī nu kho vivariṃ guyham atthaṃ, atthā ca dhammā ca avāgat' amhā.
ja518:23.1: Kathaṃkaro cā hi supaṇṇarāja kiṃsīlo kena vatena vattaṃ samaṇo caraṃ hitvā mamāyitāni kathaṃkaro saggam upeti ṭhānan ti
ja518:24.1: āha. Hiriyā titikkhāya damena khantiyā akkodhano pesuṇiyaṃ pahāya samaṇo caraṃ hitvā mamāyitāni evaṃkaro saggam upeti ṭhānan ti.
ja518:25.1: Mātā va puttaṃ taruṇaṃ tanujjaṃ sampassa taṃ sabbagattaṃ phareti evam pi me tvaṃ pātur ahu dijinda mātā va puttaṃ anukampamāno ti
ja518:26.1: gātham āha. Hand' ajja tvaṃ muñca vadhā dujivha tayo hi puttā na hi añño atthi: antevāsī dinnako atrajo ca, rajassu, putt' aññataro me ahosīti.
ja518:27.1: Icc-eva vākyaṃ visajī supaṇṇo bhumyā patiṭṭhāya dijo dujivhaṃ: mutt' ajja tvaṃ sabbabhayātivatto thalūdake bohi mayābhigutto.
ja518:28.1: Ātaṃkinaṃ yathā kusalo bhisakko pipāsitānaṃ [udaka] rahado va sīto vesmaṃ yathā himasisiraṭṭitānaṃ evam pi te saraṇam ahaṃ bhavāmīti.
ja518:29.1: Sandhiṃ katvā amittena aṇḍajena jalābuja (= II 53|15) vivariya dāṭhaṃ sayasi, kuto taṃ bhayaṃ āgatan ti.
ja518:30.1: Saṃketh eva amittasmiṃ, mittasmim pi na vissase, (II 53|22) abhayā bhayam uppannaṃ api mūlāni kantati.
ja518:31.1: Kathan nu vissase tyamhi yenāsi kalaho kato, niccayattena ṭhātabbaṃ, so disamhi na rajjati
ja518:32.1: Vissāsaye na ca naṃ vissaseyya, asaṃkito ca saṃkito bhaveyya, tathā tathā viññū parakkameyya yathā yathā bhāvaṃ paro na jaññā
ja518:33.1: ti. Te devavaṇṇī sukhumālarūpā ubho samā sujayo puññagandhā apāgamuṃ kārambiyaṃ acelaṃ missībhūtā assavāhā va nāgā
ja518:34.1: ti āha. Tato have Paṇḍarako acelaṃ sayam [evaṃ] upāgamma idaṃ avoca: mutt' ajj' ahaṃ sabbabhayātivatto, na ha nūna tuyhaṃ manaso piy' amhā ti.
ja518:35.1: Piyo hi me āsi supaṇṇarājā asaṃsayaṃ Paṇḍarakena saccaṃ, so rāgaratto va akāsim etaṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ sampajāno na mohā ti.
ja518:36.1: Na me piyaṃ appiyaṃ vāpi hoti sampassato lokam imaṃ parañ ca, (IV 127|17) susaññatānaṃ hi viyañjanena asaññato lokam imaṃ carāsi.
ja518:37.1: Ariyāvakāso si anariyo cāsi asaññato saññatasannikāso, kaṇhābhijātiko si anariyarūpo, pāpaṃ bahuṃ duccaritaṃ acārīti.
ja518:38.1: Aduṭṭhassa tuvaṃ dūbhi dūbhī ca pisuṇo c' asi, etena saccavajjena muddhā [te] phalatu sattadhā
ja518:39.1: ti. Tasmā hi mittānaṃ na dubbhitabbaṃ. mittaddubhā pāpiyo n' atthi añño, āsittasatto nihato pathavyā, {Indassa} vākyena hi {Saṃvaro} hato ti.
